response.justification: The candidate is an experienced senior full-stack engineer with a strong web/backend background (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) and solid engineering practices, but the profile does not align with this embedded networking security role. There is no evidence of native-level Japanese proficiency (a hard requirement), no Linux kernel analysis or source modification experience, no L2/L3 networking, switch, or security-protocol experience (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP, NETCONF), and only brief, decade-old C/C++ work at National Instruments rather than sustained UNIX C firmware development. The gaps are on mandatory qualifications, not nice-to-haves.
strengths: 13+ years of professional software development experience
Strong testing/TDD, CI/CD, and Linux tooling background
Some C/C++ exposure (NI LabWindows/CVI, audio server project)
concerns: No indication of Japanese language proficiency
No embedded networking, switch, or security-protocol experience
No Linux kernel analysis or modification; C skills dated and secondary

key_factors.factor: Limited recent C / Linux kernel work
